parameters.time: 2 h dwell at 1100 °C + 2 h dwell at 1900 °C

evidence.quote: followed by two-stage hydrogen sintering: initial heating to 1100 °C with a gradient of 10 °C/min with isothermal dwell for 2 h, subsequent heating to 1900 °C at 8 °C/min with 2 h dwell, and furnace cooling at 8 °C/min to obtain sintered TZM billets of 60 mm in diameter.

parameters.time: inter-pass reheating every two passes for 2 min
parameters.deformation: rough rolling: 10 passes to 15 mm, per-pass deformation 15-20%; finish rolling: 5 passes to 7 mm, per-pass reductions 5-10%
parameters.strain_rate: rough rolling: 3.5 s^-1; finish rolling: 2.7 s^-1

evidence.quote: The sintered billets were subjected to multi-pass isothermal rolling at 1200 °C. The initial rough rolling consisted of 10 passes to reduce the thickness to 15 mm, with a per-pass deformation of 15-20 % and an average strain rate of 3.5 s-1. Subsequently, the finish rolling involved 5 passes to achieve a final thickness of 7 mm, with per-pass reductions of 5-10 % and an average strain rate of 2.7 s-1. Inter-pass reheating was conducted every two passes in a protective argon atmosphere by placing the plates in a furnace at 1200 °C for 2 min. After rolling, the plates were air-cooled to room temperature, designated as ZT.

attributes.morphology: alternately composed of bundled grains and deformation bands (DBs)

evidence.quote: The HL structures in as-rolled TZM alloy present α-fiber and γ-fiber textures, which are alternately composed of bundled grains and deformation bands (DBs).

attributes.morphology: banded structures along rolling direction, associated with micro-shear bands and kink-like deformation features

evidence.quote: DBs formed along the rolling direction (RD) in the ZT sample (Fig. 2(a)), with Ti/Zr-enriched oxide particles (blue arrows) uniformly dispersed (Fig. 2(g)).
